briefdescription.para: lowerDynamicAlloc - Generate the code for allocating an object in the current frame.

detaileddescription.para: The sequence of code will be in the general form
addi R0, SP, #frameSize ; get the address of the previous frame stwxu R0, SP, Rnegsize ; add and update the SP with the negated size addi Rnew, SP, #maxCalFrameSize ; get the top of the allocation

briefdescription.para: To accomplish dynamic stack allocation, we have to calculate exact size subtracted from the stack pointer according alignment information and get previous frame pointer.
lowerCRSpilling - Generate the code for spilling a CR register.

detaileddescription.para: Instead of reserving a whole register (R0), we scrounge for one here. This generates code like this:
mfcr rA ; Move the conditional register into GPR rA. rlwinm rA, rA, SB, 0, 31 ; Shift the bits left so they are in CR0's slot. stw rA, FI ; Store rA to the frame.

briefdescription.para: Remove any STXVP[X] instructions and split them out into a pair of STXV[X] instructions if disable-auto-paired-vec-st is specified on the command line.
lowerACCSpilling - Generate the code for spilling the accumulator register.

detaileddescription.para: Similarly to other spills/reloads that use pseudo-ops, we do not actually eliminate the FrameIndex here nor compute the stack offset. We simply create a real instruction with an FI and rely on eliminateFrameIndex to handle the FI elimination.
